narrative: Material PL3__MCBEE8AD exhibits intermittent demand with a bimodal pattern. Lead time averages 1.13 days with high variability (std=0.88 days, CV=78%). A declining trend is detected over the observation period. The optimized policy recommends 4,155 units safety stock and order quantity of 9,639 units, constrained by storage capacity of 13,795 units. This represents an 81.6% cost reduction compared to current SAP settings.

The (r,Q) model is appropriate for high-volume items with stochastic lead times; the combined variance formula for sigma_LTD captures both demand and lead time variability effectively, ensuring the 95% service level is met without overstocking.
